_doc: Maps CA CCRC universe entries to obligor-level credit files for COVID-stress 2019-12-31 snapshot. Key difference from 2022 snapshot: Front Porch and Covia were SEPARATE obligors in 2019; merger only announced June 2020, effective Apr 2021, consummated March 2022.

humangood_ca_og_rollups.note: At 2019-12-31 the HGCOG had just been formed in August 2019. All 14 communities (Plymouth Village, Royal Oaks, Piedmont Gardens, Redwood Terrace, Regents Point, Rosewood, Royal Oaks, Terraces at Los Altos, Terraces of Los Gatos, Terraces at San Joaquin Gardens, Valle Verde, Westminster Gardens, White Sands La Jolla, Casa de Manana, Grand Lake Gardens) rolled up.

front_porch_rollups_2019.note: At 2019-12-31, Front Porch was a SEPARATE A-rated obligor with ~11 communities. Did NOT yet include Covia communities.

community_universe_entries_rolled_up: San Francisco Towers / St. Paul's Towers (Oakland)
covia_rollups_2019.note: At 2019-12-31, Covia was a SEPARATE A--rated obligor (formerly Episcopal Senior Communities). Affiliated with Front Porch April 2021, merger completed March 2022.

community_universe_entries_rolled_up: Sequoia Living (fka Northern California Presbyterian Homes and Services)
sequoia_living_rollups.note: At 2019-12-31, Sequoia had 3 mature LPCs. Viamonte Senior Living (Walnut Creek) was under construction with Series 2018 Cal-Mortgage insured bonds; opened December 2020.

excluded_from_universe_at_2019.name: Pacific Retirement Services — Mirabella SF Bay
excluded_from_universe_at_2019.reason: Not yet built/financed in CA; PRS at 2019 was Oregon/national, not CA muni obligor

ccrc_defaults_in_ca_during_window_NOT_in.name: California-Nevada Methodist Homes (CNMH)
ccrc_defaults_in_ca_during_window_NOT_in.outcome: Sold to Pacifica Companies LLC Feb 2022 for $34M
ccrc_defaults_in_ca_during_window_NOT_in.reason_not_in_universe: Sold and converted to rental; CCRC contracts discontinued; not in 2025 universe scope
ccrc_defaults_in_ca_during_window_NOT_in.framework_implication: If we had included CNMH in 2019 snapshot universe (which we should for backtest completeness), framework would have flagged it via low DCOH, high SNF mix, weak occupancy — and outcome (Ch 11) would CONFIRM framework. Strongest backtest evidence.

_note: Counts add up differently from 2025 snapshot because of pre-merger structures. 19 obligor files for 2025; 20 for 2019 (Front Porch + Covia separate).
